dump_results: dump 3D object detection results including point clouds, bounding boxes, and labels to a directory as PLY and OBJ files
softmax: compute softmax probabilities along the last axis of a numpy array for objectness score conversion
dump_point_clouds: dump input point clouds, seed points, vote points, and aggregated vote points as PLY files
dump_predicted_bboxes: dump predicted oriented bounding boxes filtered by objectness confidence threshold and NMS mask as PLY files
dump_ground_truth: dump ground truth bounding boxes, centroid points, and objectness labels as PLY and OBJ files
